item.title: FM Araghchi receives Tajik delegation
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – A high-ranking Tajik delegation held talks with Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi in Tehran Saturday, as part of an official visit aimed at deepening diplomatic and economic cooperation between the two neigbors.

item.title: Imam Khomeini Intl. Airport CEO visits Mehr HQ
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Ramin Kashefazar. CEO of Imam Khomeini Airport City located in the south of Tehran toured Mehr headquarters in downtown the Iranian capital and sat down for an interview with the Mehr Economic desk.

item.title: Trump recognized Resistance Front in MoU signed with Iran
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Parliament Speaker Mohammad-Bagher Ghalibaf says US President Donald Trump had given the US recognition to the Axis of Resistance by signing the Islamabad Memorandum of Understanding (MoU).

item.title: Iran urges ICRC to pursue case of 3 pilots held in Qatar
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Brigadier General Mohammad Bagherzadeh, commander of the Iranian Armed Forces General Staff’s committee for missing personnel, has urged the ICRC to follow up on the case of three Iranian pilots held as captives in Qatar.

item.title: Hezbollah vows not to leave Israeli attacks unanswered
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Lebanese Resistance movement Hezbollah has announced to respond to the continued Israeli aggression on south of the country.

item.title: Multiple people shot at Virginia State University
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – A shooting involving multiple suspects and multiple people shot at Virginia State University prompted a campus lockdown early Saturday. None of their injuries appeared to be life-threatening, the university said.

item.title: Bulk of polluted waters in shores of Qeshm cleaned up
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – A local official in the southern Hormozgan Province has said that major parts of the polluted waters in the shores of Qeshm Islamd has been cleaned up of the recent oil slick

item.title: Iran urges ICRC's probe into fate of 3 pilots held in Qatar
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA)– For 1st time, Iran has publicly said three Air Force pilots, who went missing after March 2 strike on a US military base in Qatar, were captured alive by Qatari army, calling for ICRC to investigate their condition for release.

item.title: Increasing arsenals won’t enhance global peace: Iranian envoy
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iran’s ambassador to Germany, referring to a new report on a surge in global arms transfers, has said that lasting security across the world cannot be achieved through military bases, arsenals, and nuclear weapons.

item.title: Iran seeks to strengthen ties with India: Pezeshkian to Modi
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Congratulating the National Day of India to the president, prime minister, government and people of India, Iranian President Masoud Pezeshkian has said his country is seeking to bolster relations with India in all fields.

item.title: Iran, Tajikistan to sign long-term agreement in energy field
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Officials from Tehran and Dushanbe will ink a long-term cooperation agreement for the export of petroleum products and the supply of crude oil to Tajikistan’s refineries.

item.title: Iran's envoy slams 168 days of intl. silence over Minab crime
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iran’s Ambassador to the Russian Federation Kazem Jalali has hit back at 168 days of silence by the international organizations over Minab Elementary School’s crimes committed by the United States and Israeli regime jointly.

item.title: Intel. Min. warns France against meddling in Iran's affairs
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iran’s Intelligence Ministry has warned France against interfering in country’s internal affairs, pointed to French diplomats’ involvement in a foreign infiltration project.

item.title: US policy towards Iran driven by extreme reliance on lies
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Lashing out at the US policy towards Iran, Iranian Foreign Minister Esmaeil Baghaei has said that the US system of governance & foreign policy regarding Iran and the region finds itself due to its extreme reliance on 'lies.

item.title: Iran warns France after diplomats detained in Tehran
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iranian intelligence ministry said documents seized during the arrest of two suspects revealed a French-designed project involving infiltration and covert networking inside Iran.

item.title: Magnitude 5.0 earthquake strikes near Granada, Spain
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – A magnitude 5.0 earthquake struck near the Spanish city of Granada in the autonomous community of Andalusia, the kingdom's National Geographic Institute reported.

item.title: Iran warns Trump against adventurism in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iran's judiciary chief said Saturday the Strait of Hormuz is an "inseparable part" of Iranian territorial waters, telling Trump that "what multi-billion-dollar carriers could not achieve will not be achieved with tweets.

item.title: IRGC downs US-made MQ-9 drone over Iran's Hormozgan prov.
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – The Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps (IRGC) has said that a US-made MQ-9 Reaper drone has been shot down over the southern Iranian province of Hormozgan.

item.title: 7 killed in Israeli attack on southern Lebanon
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – The death toll from an Israeli air attack on the southern Lebanese town of Ansar has risen to seven, according to local media.

item.title: Oil tanker hit by drone while exiting Strait of Hormuz: UKMTO
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – An oil tanker was struck by a drone while making an “outbound transit” through the Strait of Hormuz on Thursday, the UK Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) said Friday.

item.title: Vessel reportedly struck in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – The UK Maritime Trade Organisation (UKMTO) reported that a vessel has been struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.

item.title: VIDEO: Powerful 7.7- magnitude quake rips through Indonesia
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Video shows the initial moments of a powerful 7.7-magnitude earthquake at a university in Indonesia, as intense shaking sent students scrambling for safety.

item.title: IRGC chief praises armed forces after 6 months of war
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi praised Iranian forces for standing against what he called the world's most heavily armed military over six months of war.

item.title: 6 killed, suspect dead in shootings in US State of Michigan
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – A series of shootings in Michigan left six people plus a suspect dead Friday, police said, following an extensive search around two homes and a wooded area.

item.title: Pezeshkian hails Iran girls' historic weightlifting feat
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – President Masoud Pezeshkian praised Iran's young female weightlifters after they secured the country's first runner-up finish at an Asian championship, calling it a valuable milestone for the sport.

item.title: No decision made so far on resuming talks with US
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iran has not decided to resume negotiations with the United States, Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi said, adding that the 60-day period in the Islamabad MoU was a window for talks, not a ceasefire subject to extension.

item.title: No one can seize Strait of Hormuz by tweets, Iran warns Trump
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Iran's deputy foreign minister said the Strait of Hormuz can only be closed or reopened by Tehran's command, rejecting President Trump's claim that Washington will declare the strategic waterway U.S. territory.

item.title: Israeli regime violates Lebanon truce, strikes Syria
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 15 (MNA) – Israeli forces attacked multiple areas of southern Lebanon on Saturday and set farmland ablaze in southern Syria's Quneitra countryside, Lebanese and Syrian media reported.

item.title: Production, delivery of Iran's air defense sys. go on: IRGC
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 14 (MNA) – A senior officer of Iran’s Islamic Revolution Guards Corps (IRGC) Aerospace Force says production and delivery of the country’s air defense systems have continued without interruption after the 40-day US-Israeli aggression.

item.title: Araghchi, Austrian FM discuss ties, regional issues in call
item.description: TEHRAN, Aug. 14 (MNA) – Iranian Foreign Minister Seyed Abbas Araghchi held a telephone conversation Thursday with his Austrian counterpart, Beate Meinl-Reisinger, to discuss bilateral relations alongside pressing regional and international issues.
